data.name: Rafiq
data.gender_notes: Rafiq is used as a male name in islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: From the Arabic root ر-ف-ق (r-f-q), 'to be gentle'. Rafīq means 'companion, gentle'. Its root is ر-ف-ق (r-f-q). A common Muslim given name. Rafiq is a Arabic name meaning “Companion; friend; gentle”. Families who choose it generally do so for the quality the name expresses.
data.spiritual_meaning: Rafiq expresses “Companion; friend; gentle”; spiritual readings of the name are interpretive.
data.etymology: From the Arabic root ر-ف-ق (r-f-q), 'to be gentle'. Rafīq means 'companion, gentle'.
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Rafiq total 33, reducing to 6. Number 6 is associated with responsibility, care and harmony.
